curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42069-1-1.pdf (one book: finished vehicle step 555 page 387, functions pages 388-389)

functions.does: The knob on the roof, behind the windscreen, steers the front track units: an upright shaft with a universal joint comes down to bevel gears and a long shaft forward to a 12 tooth bevel gear on the steering rack, which swings both front track units on their turntables.
functions.source: book: pages 388-389 (top left inset: front tracks steering; the knob on the roof with its arrow); the gears are read from the model

functions.does: The knob on the right side of the body (the side with the right door) winds the winch in the front bumper: through bevel gears, an upright shaft and a shaft forward with universal joints, it turns a 20 tooth bevel gear that turns the reel, pulling the hook in or letting it out.
functions.source: book: page 388 (bottom inset: the hook pulled in, small inset: the knob on the side); the gears are read from the model

functions.does: A ratchet on the winch stops it unwinding under load.
functions.source: inferred: the winch ratchet submodel (p329 41678 and the parts with it)
functions.skip: a ratchet; only matters under force

functions.does: The knob on the left side of the body raises the back of the roof, with its rack and jerry cans, on a linear actuator: the knob's 20 tooth bevel gear turns a cross shaft whose bevel gear turns the actuator's 12 tooth gear.
functions.source: book: page 389 (top right inset: the roof raised; the knob on the side with its arrow); the gears and actuator are read from the model
functions.note: Unsure what exactly rises: the book's inset shows the roof rack and jerry cans tilted up over a white panel. In the model the actuator lifts a frame under the two rear roof panels (p1214, p1215), which are hinged to the roof, and the roof with its rack is hinged at the front (p661 24316).

functions.does: Pushing the vehicle along turns the V8 engine's pistons: the rear differential drives a shaft forward to the crankshaft.
functions.source: inferred: the engine and its drive are in the model; the function pages don't show it

functions.does: The four track units roll; each pivots on its axle to follow the ground.
functions.source: book: page 387 (finished vehicle); that they pivot is inferred

functions.does: Each front door swings open, and a steering link from the door lowers the side step under it.
functions.source: book: page 388 (middle inset: the door swung up, the step lowered)
functions.note: The left door (p1172, doorleft) works the step p1150; the right door (p1055, doorright) works p1033.

functions.does: The rear door, with the spare wheel on it, swings open, and the white tray inside slides out.
functions.source: book: page 389 (middle right inset: door open, tray sliding out)
functions.note: The tray (p722 and the trunk parts after it) isn't fastened: it only slides in.

functions.does: The side panel at the back on each side flips up, showing the first aid kit and fire extinguisher stowed behind it.
Shock absorbers on each axle let the track units rise and fall.
functions.source: book: page 387 (shock absorbers drawn over each axle)

questions.question: What does the actuator lift, the whole roof or its rear panels?
